meta.name: security
meta.description: Security review and vulnerability analysis. Use when handling sensitive data, authentication, authorization, input validation, or any security-relevant code. Based on OWASP Top 10 patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码并发现安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的代码涉及登录、权限或用户输入，需要确认没有安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Find security vulnerabilities in your code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code involves login, permissions, or user input and you need to verify security.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以安全审查员身份检查代码，对照 OWASP Top 10 清单找出访问控制、注入、加密等方面漏洞，并给出修复建议。它会提醒避免硬编码密钥、使用参数化查询等安全写法。
howto.when: 当你提到“认证”“用户输入”“数据库查询”等安全关键词，或要求做安全审查、处理敏感数据时触发。

say.text: 这段登录代码有安全漏洞吗？
say.note: Claude 会按 OWASP 标准检查认证逻辑。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 API 端点的输入验证。
say.note: 它会检查注入和访问控制风险。

say.text: 我的数据库查询写法安全吗？
say.note: 它会提示是否该用参数化查询。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews code as a security expert, checking against OWASP Top 10 for access control, injection, crypto, and misconfiguration, and recommends fixes. It flags hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, and urges parameterized queries.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention security-related keywords such as 'authentication', 'user input', 'database queries', or ask for a security review or handle sensitive data.

say_en.note: Claude will check auth logic against OWASP.

say_en.text: Review input validation for this API endpoint.
say_en.note: It will look for injection and access control issues.
It will suggest parameterized queries if needed.
